function.name: list_directory
function.description: List the current working directory or a specified path as a bounded tree. Omit path for the current folder. Paths are literal JSON strings, so spaces need no shell quoting. Symlinks are not followed; service directories are not traversed unless explicitly targeted.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a bounded UTF-8 text or supported document fragment. Paths are literal, relative to the working directory or explicit absolute paths. For more content copy next_offset and revision exactly into offset and revision; stop when eof is true. Offsets count bytes or extracted characters as stated in the result. Secret/system paths are unavailable here.
